answer: Lock every completed unit for 45 days before it counts, and expire the standing it earned if 45 more pass without new work. Auditors come from a rotating pool, so a small team meets a new reviewer each cycle and cannot befriend one. Think of it as a voyage: the quill only writes while the ship moves, and there is no velvet cushion of idle balance to sit on. For a five-person shop that is fair; for a farm it means real work on every identity, every cycle.
